text.caraca_customs.command.reload_succe: §a[Caraca Customs] Configurations and berry mechanics reloaded successfully!
tooltip.caraca_customs.custom_balls_enab: When enabled, the custom Poké Balls can be crafted and found in chests, Cobblemon's Poké, Premier, Azure, Citrine, Roseate, Slate and Verdant ball recipes craft the custom versions, and they replace those balls in the creative tab. Recipes update right after saving or /caraca reload.
tooltip.caraca_customs.regular_ball_mate: Item the regular Poké Ball recipes ask for, in place of the Copper Ingot. The rest of each recipe stays the same. Recipes update right after saving or /caraca reload.
tooltip.caraca_customs.ultra_ball_materi: Item the Ultra Poké Ball recipes ask for, in place of the Quartz. The rest of each recipe stays the same. Recipes update right after saving or /caraca reload.
tooltip.caraca_customs.ultra_ball_corner: Item the Ultra Poké Ball recipes also ask for in each empty corner of the crafting grid (4 in total), whatever the Ultra material is. Nothing by default. Recipes update right after saving or /caraca reload.
tooltip.caraca_customs.berry_mechanics_e: When enabled, berries use this mod's growth times, yields, Hoe Fortune bonus and limited mulch uses. When disabled, berries behave like in Cobblemon.
tooltip.caraca_customs.follow_speed_enab: When enabled, your sent out Pokémon follow you at a distance based on their size and speed up when they fall behind, so they don't need to teleport to catch up. Wild Pokémon aren't affected.
tooltip.caraca_customs.level_cap_enabled: When enabled, your Pokémon can only level up to the cap of your current tier. Catch more species to unlock higher tiers.
tooltip.caraca_customs.tier_count: How many tiers the progression has (1 to 20). Max level is split evenly between them, and the last tier always reaches Cobblemon's max level. Ex: 6 tiers = caps of 16, 32, 48, 64, 80 and 100
option.caraca_customs.max_tier_capture_c: Species Needed for the Last Tier
tooltip.caraca_customs.max_tier_capture_: Different species you need to catch to reach the last tier (50 to 1025). Each tier needs an equal share of it, and the leftover goes to the last tier. Ex: 512 with 6 tiers = 0, 85, 170, 255, 340 and 512
text.caraca_customs.level_cap.reached: %s reached your level cap (%s). Register %s more species to reach tier %s and raise the cap to level %s!
text.caraca_customs.tier.up: You reached tier %s of %s! Your Pokémon can now level up to %s.
text.caraca_customs.command.tier.header: %s is on tier %s of %s, with %s species caught.
text.caraca_customs.command.tier.next: Next tier at %s species, raising the level cap to %s.
text.caraca_customs.command.tier.solo: This player progresses alone, outside the shared tiers.
text.caraca_customs.command.sharedex.reb: Shared Pokédex rebuilt from %s players: %s species.
text.caraca_customs.tier.up_shared: %s registered a new species! Everyone reached tier %s of %s! Your Pokémon can now level up to %s.
text.caraca_customs.tier.up_shared_no_ca: %s registered a new species! Everyone reached tier %s of %s!
tooltip.caraca_customs.exp_share_all_ena: When enabled, every Pokémon in your party gets experience when one of them defeats an opponent, as if the whole party held Exp. Shares. How it's split is set in the Progression tab.
tooltip.caraca_customs.exp_division: Shared splits the active Pokémon's experience between the whole party. Multiplied gives every other member a copy of it, scaled by the EXP Multiplier. Ex: 100 exp, party of 4 = 25 each when shared, or 100 and 50 each multiplied at 0.5
tooltip.caraca_customs.exp_share_method: Only used by the Shared division. Equally gives everyone the same slice. Balanced lets the active Pokémon keep half and splits the other half between the rest of the party. Ex: 100 exp, party of 4 = 50 for the active Pokémon and about 17 each
tooltip.caraca_customs.exp_share_multipl: Only used by the Multiplied division. Share of the active Pokémon's experience every other party member gets (0 to 1). Held items like the Lucky Egg only boost the Pokémon holding them. Ex: 0.8 = 80%
tooltip.caraca_customs.exp_share_item_bo: Extra experience every party member holding a Lucky Egg adds to the Pokémon holding an Exp. Share (0 to 100). With more than one Exp. Share, the bonus is split between them. Only while Exp. Share All is on. Ex: 0.5 with 4 Lucky Eggs and 2 Exp. Shares = +1x each, so 2x the experience
tooltip.caraca_customs.player_shared_tie: When enabled, the different species caught by every player count together to unlock tiers. Ex: two players with 40 different species each reach the tier that needs 80
tooltip.caraca_customs.tier_share_blockl: Players in this list don't share tiers: they unlock new ones with their own caught species only, and their captures don't count for the others.
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_cap_enabled: When enabled, stronger Pokémon only spawn naturally around players with a high enough tier. Pokémon outside every group spawn normally.
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_levels_enab: When enabled, natural Pokémon spawn between a minimum level and your level cap, mostly in the average range set in the Progression tab. The minimum is half the cap minus 3 (cap under 50), minus 5 (under 80) or minus 10. Ex: cap 32 = levels 13 to 32, mostly 21 to 28.
tooltip.caraca_customs.average_spawn_lev: Where the most common spawn levels start, from 0 to 1 of the way between the minimum spawn level and your level cap. Ex: 0.4 with levels 1 to 20 = level 9
Where the most common spawn levels end, from 0 to 1 of the way between the minimum spawn level and your level cap. Ex: 0.8 with levels 1 to 20 = level 16

Minimum share of natural Pokémon spawning with a level from the average range (0 to 1). Levels outside it get rarer the further they are from it, so the minimum level and the level cap are the rarest. Ex: 0.65 = at least 65%
tooltip.caraca_customs.tier_species_surp: From 0 to 2. Each tier always offers enough spawnable species to reach the next one, plus this extra share. If it doesn't, the next groups are unlocked early at their early tier rate. Ex: 0.4 (the default) = a tier leading to one that needs 100 species offers at least 140
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_group.start: Tier in which this group starts spawning with its max spawn rate. Can't be higher than the tier count.
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_group.max_s: From 0.01 to 100. Multiplies the original spawn rate of this group's Pokémon. Ex: 0.01 = 1% of the original rate, 3 = 300%
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_group.reduc: From 0 to 3. How many tiers before the starting tier this group already spawns. The tier right before gets the early tier spawn rate (25% by default), and each earlier tier gets half of that. Ex: 2 = 12.5%, then 25%, then 100%
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_group.early: From 0.01 to 1. Share of the max spawn rate this group gets in the tier right before its starting tier, and when it has to be unlocked early to fill a tier. Ex: 0.25 = 25%, 0.5 = 50%
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_group.reduc: Tier in which this group reaches its max reduced rate, going down in equal steps from the starting tier. Must be higher than the starting tier. 0 = no reduction
tooltip.caraca_customs.spawn_group.max_r: From 0.01 to 99.99, and always at least 0.01 below the max multiplier. Multiplier reached at the reduction tier. Ex: 0.5 = 50% of the original rate. 0 = no reduction
tooltip.caraca_customs.caracatron_color: Screen color of your Caracatron 3000. Only changes how it looks for you, even on servers. It can also be changed in the select at the top of the Caracatron's screen
tooltip.caraca_customs.caracatron_scan_s: From 1x to 5x. How many times faster the Caracatron 3000 scans Pokémon than a Pokédex, when holding the use button. 2x by default
